FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Before working
with us.

Scope, costs, timelines and maintenance.

What happens in the first session?+

We discuss your business, the problem you want to solve and your priorities. Then we determine whether you need a website, software, IT support or a combination. The date and time are arranged via WhatsApp.

Do I need everything figured out to start?+

No. Bring an idea or a need. We help you clarify your goal and define a scope that fits your business.

How much does a project cost and how long does it take?+

It depends on the scope, features and content. Once we understand your needs, we prepare a proposal with the investment, deliverables and timeline before starting.

Can you support me after delivery?+

Yes. We offer maintenance, updates and IT support. Hours, visits and response times are defined in each service proposal.
